label: Review HTML
_specSource: design.md §5 Density Floors (sectionPairGap 24 · bodyTextGap 12 · cardBoxGap 16) · §'Extension governance' rules 1-5 (--review-/--severity-/--layer- namespaces · WCAG comment required) · §3 'CJK / i18n font fallback'
_cjkRule: review-HTML status/layer tags render CN in MONO (改/删/D 精简) · dim #4 flags literal mono/serif stacks lacking a CJK font when the file contains CJK; var(--font-*) tokens are trusted. Spec root: design.md §3 'CJK / i18n font fallback'.

extensions.rule: WCAG ratio comment required on each new --color-* extension (design.md §'Extension governance' rule 2)
forbidden: extension token without WCAG ratio comment

_bpReference.note: tag orthogonality (2 profiles · editorial 3x4 / technical 3x3) is an extension pattern, NOT a spec rule · enforcement is at build-time (html-review-skill), not audit-time
